paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.05% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.46%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.86%). Brent crude changed +2.40% to 117.64. Gold changed -3.29% to 3,898.8999. Bitcoin changed +0.21% to 77,361.1406. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.929%, a relative move of -1.20%. Among the firms tracked, Jefferies (-6.16%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-5.55%) moved the most.
